# `const-changed`

const changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` in requests, `error` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `const-changed` (both directions), `const-changed-in-request`, `const-changed-in-response` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A `const` value changed.

## Why this default

Clients send or expect the old value.

## Example

From test case [`const-changed`](../../test/cases/const-changed/): A const value changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          name:
            type: string
-           const: a
+           const: b
```

Findings:

- `const-changed-in-response` · error · #/components/schemas/Pet

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  const-changed: error
```

## How to fix

Add a new property, or use an enum with both values during a transition.
